dialoginput.page-setup-margins.note: dialoginput override-only: Page setup dialog #ps-mt=2.5in/#ps-mr=0.75in + Apply -> writePageSetupMarker writes data-margin-top=3600 / data-margin-right=1080 twips on the .page-setup marker (editor.js btn-ps-apply: Math.round(inches*1440))

dialoginput.page-setup-size.note: dialoginput override-only: Page setup dialog size select Legal (12240x20160 twips, apply path splits ps-size WxH value) + #ps-mb=2in -> marker data-page-w/h + data-margin-bottom=2880

dialoginput.page-setup-custom-size.note: dialoginput override-only: Page setup dialog size select Custom exercises the psSize.value==='custom' branch (rememberCustomSize + dialog dataset.w/h fallback -> 11906x16838 portrait on a fresh page) -> marker written with data-orient

dialoginput.columns-count-gap.note: dialoginput override-only: Columns dialog #columns-count=4/#columns-gap=80 + Insert -> confirmColumnsDialog insertHTML <section data-columns=4 data-column-gap=80> at the caret

dialoginput.watermark-custom-text.note: dialoginput override-only: Watermark ribbon button -> dialog, wm-mode=custom unhides #wm-text, fill TOPSECRET (no spaces: setSectionMarker splits attrs on whitespace) + color Red -> div.watermark marker data-text/data-color
